---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Greta Tillery"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
district_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score)
district_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2023 = rla_score)
score_change <- inner_join(
  district_2015,
  district_2023,
  by = c("district_id", "district_name", "state")
) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()
state_scores <- tbl(con, "state_scores")
state_2015 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score)
state_2023 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2023 = rla_score)
state_change <- inner_join(
  state_2015,
  state_2023,
  by = c("stateabb", "state_name")
) |>
  mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()
print(state_change)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  mutate(change_direction = case_when(
    rla_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
    rla_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
    TRUE ~ "No change"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "District Changes in Reading Scores",
    subtitle = paste(n_distinct(score_change$district_id), "districts"),
    x = "Change in reading score (2023 minus 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change direction",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline."
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023),
    change_direction = case_when(
      score_change > 0 ~ "Improved",
      score_change < 0 ~ "Declined",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name, color = change_direction)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = state_name),
    arrow = arrow(length = grid::unit(0.15, "inches"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray") +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows show each state's change in reading score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Direction of change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrowheads mark 2023 scores."
  )
```
